patthana15.55:1.1: na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbahetuko na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana15.55:2.1: dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbahetuko na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.55:3.1: na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbahetuko na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: dve. abyākatavāre sabbattha paccayavasena gaṇetabbaṃ. bhāvanāyapahātabbahetukaduka kusalattike nabhāvanāyapahātabbahetukaduka nakusalattikaṃ
